task.description: Validate test design for ISS-204 and ISS-206. Hard gate.
acceptance_criteria: All MUST cases have runnable tests

result.summary: HARD GATE: PASS. All MUST requirements have test coverage. ISS-204: 3 test cases (same-tx commit, rollback no orphan, before/after state). ISS-206: 4 test cases covered by existing unit tests (TC-EE-06-01..05 for parallel split, TC-EE-07-01..05 for parallel join, TC-EE-02-11 for determinism). No SkipZigTest on MUST tests. Per-test UUIDs used. No mocks or stubs. Integration tests check BPM_TEST_DB_URL where needed.
